goal: Add photo semantic search index to search visits by visual concepts

steps.description: Implement api/photo_search.py connecting semantic photo search with timeline visit matching and in-memory LRU caching
Integrate photo semantic search into api/routes/search.py and add api/visits/search endpoint
Update static/app.js and static/style.css to render photo-matched visits with thumbnails and jump-to-visit highlighting
Verify contract tests, schema integrity, and end-to-end integration
